name: Katugas Ella
description: Katugas Ella, a plunge in Ratnapura, Sri Lanka, offers visitors a chance to swim, picnic, and take nature walks. The waterfall, though unnamed in local folklore, has been a popular spot for locals and tourists alike, known for its refreshing waters and lush surroundings. Its significance lies in being a natural oasis amidst the dry zone, attracting wildlife and offering a respite from the heat. Historically, the area was part of ancient kingdoms, and tales speak of ancient rituals performed here by local communities. Today, it remains a cherished spot for those seeking tranquility and adventure.
monsoon_note: Best visited Jan-Apr. Paths may flood during monsoon.

name: Pahanthudawa Falls
description: Pahanthudawa Falls, nestled in Ratnapura, Sri Lanka, offer a breathtaking cascade perfect for swimming, photography, and picnicking. Visitors can immerse themselves in the cool waters, marvel at the cascading beauty, and capture memorable moments. Nearby, the lush greenery and tranquil setting make it a perfect spot for a picnic.

name: Kirindi Ella
description: Kirindi Ella, a tiered waterfall in Ratnapura, Sri Lanka, offers visitors a picturesque setting for hiking, photography, and picnicking. Historically, the area has been an important source of water supply for the nearby villages, and local legends tell of ancient rituals performed at the site by the Sinhalese people. Today, it attracts nature lovers and photographers seeking inspiration in its serene landscapes.
monsoon_note: Dry season (Feb-May) best for hiking. Paths muddy in monsoon.

name: Sinharaja Border Falls
